page.layout: One printed page, single column of text; a large ornamented title block at the top; a woodcut historiated initial at the left of the opening paragraph; a signature line at the foot.

main_text.head: ADMODVM ILLVSTRI ET GENEROSO COMITI AC DOMINO, Dn. Philippo Ludovico, Comiti in Hanaw & Rhieneck, Domino in Müntzenberg, &c. Sac. Cæsareæ Maiest. à Consiliis: Dn. suo clementissimo.
main_text.p: Libellus hic, DE MAGISTRATVVM IN SVBDITOS IVRE, ITIDEMQVE SVBDITORVM ERGA MAGISTRATVS SVOS OFFICIO, (admodum Illustris ac Generose Comes ac Domine, Domine clementissime) antehac, anno scilicet à nato Christo, 1576. in Gallia excusus, &c. à viro quodam, literarum fautore summo, ante menses aliquot mihi transmissus est.

page.notes: The initial letter is a woodcut "L" (opening word "Libellus"), joined to the text as printed. Long s rendered as s. Some words in the title block are set in mixed roman and italic; the line "Hunc" at the foot is the start of the next page's text and is also the catchword. Lines of the title block are reproduced as close to print as the scan allows; the ornamental border at the top is not text.
